title: Banjo Creek (Appalachian Celtic Instrumental)
style: Appalachian Celtic banjo fiddle acoustic bass bodhran 96bpm warm folk traditional Ireland Appalachia reel no vocals dancing energetic joyful textural cinematic
lyrics:
[Instrumental — banjo, fiddle, acoustic bass, bodhran]

[Opening — banjo single picking pattern]

[Fiddle enters — melody over banjo]

[Bodhran joins — Celtic pulse]

[Full reel — all instruments]

[Fiddle break — solo]

[Return — banjo and fiddle together]

[Fade]
